message.content:
The login page for **Global Saham** (GS Capital Access) is displayed. Here’s a breakdown of all visible elements:  

### Header & Branding  
- Top-left: The “Global Saham” logo with the tagline *“GS CAPITAL ACCESS”*.  
- Top-right: A “Daftar” (Register) button.  


### Main Content (Green Section)  
- A “GS LIVE” indicator (top-left of the green area).  
- The Global Saham logo (circular, centered).  
- Title: *“Masuk Investor Global Saham”* (Login as Global Saham Investor).  
- Subtitle: *“Akses akun Global Saham untuk memantau portofolio, pergerakan saham, aktivitas profit, dan layanan Investor.”* (Access your Global Saham account to monitor portfolio, stock movements, profit activities, and investor services).  
- Three feature icons (below the subtitle):  
  - *“Market”* (with “Live” label).  
  - *“125K++ Pengguna”* (125K++ Users).  
  - *“Portofolio”* (with “Akses” label).  
- A line graph (yellow) showing market trends.  


### Login Form (White Section)  
- **WhatsApp Number Field**:  
  - Label: *“NOMOR WHATSAPP”*.  
  - Input: Pre-filled with `+62 812345678901` (country code + number).  
  - Icon: Phone (green circle).  
- **Password Field**:  
  - Label: *“KATA SANDI”* (Password).  
  - Input: Placeholder *“Masukkan kata sandi”* (Enter password).  
  - Icon: Lock (green circle).  
  - “Lihat” (Show) button (to toggle password visibility).  
- **“Ingat akun”** (Remember account) checkbox (unchecked).  
- **“Lupa sandi?”** (Forgot password?) link (right-aligned, brown text).  
- **Login Button**: *“MASUK SEKARANG”* (Login Now) — green gradient button with an arrow icon.  


### Footer  
- Text: *“Belum punya akun? Daftar Global Saham”* (Don’t have an account? Register for Global Saham).  
- **Legal/Trust Section**:  
  - *“Legalitas Perusahaan”* (Company Legality) + *“Halaman resmi Global Saham”* (Official Global Saham Page).  
  - Logos (e.g., “OK” and another icon, likely for trust/certification).  
- Bottom navigation tabs: *“Investasi Aman”* (Safe Investment), *“Market Live”*, *“125K++ Pengguna”*.  


### Error Message  
There is **no error message** visible on the page. All fields appear to be in their default state (no validation errors, empty password field, pre-filled phone number).
